text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout to prod in change window (2026-03-21 22:00–22:45 UTC). Release: service-v3.2.1. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-service-v3.2.1 :rocket:
priya: Oncall ack. I'll be rollback owner for first 20m - ping me if canary stalls.
tony: I'm release lead. I'll watch latency and deployment health. Primary for pin/unpin decisions.
jia: Add: canary hold if 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p50 latency > 150ms for 5m. Escalate to SRE after 2 consecutive checks.
ops_beth: Confirm runbook includes DB feature-flag toggle and cache-lift steps (see section #db-toggle). If rollback, do NOT run cache invalidation until we confirm DB state.
sre-oncall: I'll shadow metrics and readiness. Running pre-check: `./scripts/healthcheck.sh prod service-v3.2.1` now.
laura: If we rollback, CS needs a one-line customer-facing note. Devex/Docs: please hold the changelog update until stable.
devex-maria: noted — if rollback happens I'll revert the changelog PR and update release notes template.
tony: Rollback command for ops if needed:
```
deploybot rollback --service service --env prod --to-sha sha@b7a1 --reason "canary-failure"
```
priya: Escape hatch owners: @priya primary, @tony backup, @sre-oncall for infra execs. Communication: post summary to #deploy-notify and tag @support-lead.
deploy-bot: Canary status: 1/3 stages complete — 10% traffic to v3.2.1. Observability: dashboards linked: https://grafana.redwood/service-v3.2.1/canary
priya: We're at 10m into window. No alerts yet. Keeping an eye on 5xx.
ops_beth: Quick reminder: if rollback, follow runbook step 6b for DB read-only -> then unpin service.
tony: If we decide to pin instead of rollback, pin criteria: transient latency spike < 10m and no error-rate increase. Otherwise full rollback.
jia: I'll automate a check to post a hold message to this thread if thresholds breached.
laura: After final decision, we'll update release notes and the public changelog accordingly.
priya: good — will update when we reach 50% canary or if any trigger fires. :white_check_mark:
